# Auto Hauler Exchange Announces $5M Series A Round Led by MHS Capital to Expand Vehicle Transportation Marketplace
...
‍ Detroit, MI — February 4, 2025 — Auto Hauler Exchange (AHX), the leading digital marketplace for vehicle transportation, today announced it has raised $5 million in a Series A funding round led by MHS Capital. The company plans to use the new capital to scale its operations, expand its team, and further enhance its marketplace platform, which currently, directly connects a growing network of vehicle haulers with vehicle shippers.

MHS Capital, a growth-focused venture firm, led the funding round due to the strong growth potential of AHX in the finished vehicle space. We are excited to support Royce and his team as they scale and continue to innovate in this vital industry."

# Rochester vehicle logistics startup closes $5M funding round 

 

 By Anna Fifelski 

Anna Fifelski is a reporter covering startups and technology companies in Southeast Michigan as well as banking and finance. She joined Crain's in September 2023. Fifelski is a graduate of the University of Michigan.

 By Anna Fifelski 

 A 2020 Ford Motor Co. Mustang vehicle sits on a car hauler at a dealership. 

 February 04, 2025 03:07 PM 

Auto Hauler Exchange closed a $5 million Series A funding round, the Rochester-based company announced Tuesday.
...
The vehicle logistics company is a marketplace that connects shippers and carriers directly, to give its customers “control over the entire vehicle transport process,” according to the company’s website. 

The funding round was led by San Francisco-based MHS Capital, which invests in software-as-a-service, marketplace, commerce-focused companies and more.
...
Auto Hauler Exchange raised $4.7 million of the $5 million round on Dec. 23, and was one of the Detroit area’s largest venture deals in Q4 2024, Crain’s previously reported.
...
“This investment will allow us to accelerate the development of our platform and significantly grow our network of carriers and shippers. We’re focused on providing a seamless experience for all users, making vehicle transport easier, faster, and more cost-effective,” said Royce Neubauer, founder and CEO of Auto Hauler Exchange, in a news release.
...
Toronto-based Golden Ventures, which led Auto Hauler Exchange’s seed round, also contributed to the Series A round.
...
AHX plans to put the funding toward expanding its marketplace offering, enhance its technology infrastructure, and recruit top talent to fuel its next phase of growth.

 COO Dana Randazzo, founder and CEO Royce Neubauer, and VP of Sales Frank Zombo of Auto Hauler Exchange. (Photo: AHX)
